controller_error.reason: Approved local model/digest unavailable; no fallback or download.

account_and_model_store.root_cause: Unknown; per-account default model-store mismatch is consistent with the empty inventory, but the process environment/model-store path was not accessible to verify.

preconditions_verified: PID and executable path matched the supervisor-identified process.
It was the unique listener on the approved loopback port.
The loaded-model API reported zero models.
The TCP table had no established client for the listener.
process_repair_attempt.stop_process_result: PowerShell returned 'Object reference not set to an instance of an object'.

limitations: The Windows profile for the daemon owner and its OLLAMA_MODELS process value could not be read.
The different account is a confirmed condition; the precise cause of the empty model listing is not confirmed.
The outer manifest file hash is distinct from the model digest stored in its nested manifest layer.
The daemon was not replaced because the targeted process-stop command failed; it remains alive with zero loaded models.
No model generation, unload control, package change, download, schema change or production database access occurred.
